text_simplified: Parents must teach children to fast gradually according to their physical abilities. You can start with short periods and then increase them while considering the child’s health. The goal is to accustom the child to worship without compulsion or harm.

review_defects.arabic: يمكن البدء بفترات قصيرة ثم زيادتها مع مراعاة صحة الطفل
review_defects.english: You can start with short periods and then increase them while considering the child’s health.
review_defects.why: The Arabic uses an impersonal construction 'يمكن البدء' (one can begin), while the English shifts to direct second-person 'You can start', altering the register from neutral instructional to directly addressing the reader.
